approvedCoverage: Required milestone 1-5 integer semantic matrices and defined architectural exceptions

deferred.reason: Software references disagree on CCR after rejected RTE formats; an independent expectation remains unresolved.
Ordinary STOP with a new S-clear SR disagrees with an undocumented software-reference rule.
Original trace provenance across fault, repair and retry has unresolved independent expectations; software agreement is not hardware evidence.

The 480-case broader inventory, original-frame construction, partial transfers, repair/refault, foreign frames and wider trace/interrupt protocols remain unqualified. Known bounded fixtures do not complete them.
Only the context-copy fix was approved for production. Other private continuation formats and candidates are not production qualification.

rules: Deferred coverage is visible and nonblocking for acceptance of known coverage; it is never counted as passing.
No legal case is removed from the required milestone 1-5 matrices.
An explicitly requested discovery or reference audit still fails on mismatches, unsupported execution, missing fixtures or empty selections.
Historical failing evidence and deferred discovery fixtures remain retained.
Deferral does not authorize importing another private candidate or publishing a package.
